content.json:
# CatCar Operations Dashboard
Operational health and work-order flow telemetry from the Log Analytics workspace.

content.title: Daily Work Order Volume
content.query:
AppTraces
| where tostring(Properties.EventName) == 'WorkOrderOpened'
| extend EventId = tostring(Properties.EventId)
| where isnotempty(EventId)
| summarize FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated) by EventId
| summarize WorkOrdersCreated = count() by Day = bin(FirstSeen, 1d)
| order by Day asc

content.title: Average Execution Time per Stage
content.query:
AppTraces
| where tostring(Properties.EventName) == 'WorkOrderStageCompleted'
| extend EventId = tostring(Properties.EventId), WorkOrderId = tostring(Properties.WorkOrderId), Stage = tostring(Properties.Stage), DurationSeconds = todouble(Properties.DurationSeconds)
| where isnotempty(EventId) and isnotempty(WorkOrderId) and isnotempty(Stage) and isnotnull(DurationSeconds)
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by EventId
| summarize DurationSeconds = sum(DurationSeconds) by WorkOrderId, Stage
| summarize AverageDurationHours = avg(DurationSeconds) / 3600.0, WorkOrders = count() by Stage
| order by Stage asc

content.title: Integration Failure Counts
content.query:
AppTraces
| where tostring(Properties.EventName) == 'WorkOrderIntegrationFailed' and SeverityLevel >= 3
| extend EventId = tostring(Properties.EventId), Component = tostring(Properties.Component)
| serialize
| extend DeduplicationKey = iff(isempty(EventId), strcat('row:', tostring(row_number())), strcat('event:', EventId))
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by DeduplicationKey
| extend Component = iff(isempty(Component), 'Unknown', Component)
| summarize FailureCount = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 1h), Component
| order by TimeGenerated asc
